children: RNS Number : 3739V  Great Portland Estates plc  18 September 2026

In accordance with UK Listing Rule 6.4.9R(2), Great Portland Estates plc (the "Company") announces that Emma Woods, a Non-Executive Director of the Company, has been appointed as a Non-Executive Director of Saga plc with effect from 18 September 2026.
